_comment: The workspace's URL shapes (P2-02, D-109). The server's path check (workspace_page.py) and the app's router (frontend/src/router.js) both read this file, so they cannot drift. Keys match Workspace Section.section in construction_core where one exists. `label` and `group` are the staff rail's, from the live design (D-124): Whiteboards are Canvas and Takeoff is Viewers; a divider separates the groups (P2-09). `rail: false`: a page never on the rail; client-view, the staff preview of one client's portal, opens from Home and Settings (P3-05, D-136).
